node.title: Re: OOP introspection
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
[LanX] has already pointed you to [doc://@ISA]. Note that if this is about method resolution order, see [doc://mro], for example it provides a mro::get_linear_isa($classname) function that may be useful.

Also in the case of composition how can I find out which class depends on which class? Or what kind of objects can be injected in the constructor of an other object?

I'm not sure I understand, could you illustrate these questions with code?
